body:
## Finding (from task 12661 CDP stress measurement, 2026-11-08)

While running the #3949 acceptance measurement (390x844, headless Chromium CDP, current main 9615ae1e11), a stress fixture for the /item session-records section — current-main `renderItem` output with a session record whose `agentLabel` is a single 136-char unbroken token — produced exactly one element beyond right=391px outside any scroll wrapper:

- `SPAN.badge.agent`, right=842px, width=821px, text "OpenCode main <136-char unbroken token>"

The `.badge` chip does not wrap, and the session-record line's first row (label `<strong>` + source badge + agent badge) has no containment rule of its own — the #3949 fix contained `.session-record-meta` (overflow-wrap: anywhere) but not the badge row. Real `agentLabel` values are registry identity display names (short today), so this needs a long/unbroken agent identity to trigger; it is an edge case, not a live-data sighting.

## Acceptance
- A session record with a long unbroken agent label (or source label) renders at 390x844 with no element right > 391px outside a deliberate scroll wrapper, verified by CDP geometry measurement (task 4896 method).
- `bun test test/mobile-targets.test.ts` stays green; add a source assertion for the badge-row containment if the fix is CSS-level (e.g. max-width + overflow-wrap on the record line's badges, or flex-wrap on the line).

Scope: pm-stack/aggregator session-record rendering only; no global CSS changes.

## Acceptance criteria

- A session record with a long unbroken agent label (or source label) renders at 390x844 with no element right > 391px outside a deliberate scroll wrapper (the issue's own Acceptance section, consolidated here — the filer's 136-char-token fixture is the test case).
- The badge row (label + source badge + agent badge) gains containment consistent with the #3949 `.session-record-meta` fix, without changing how normal short labels render.
